INVOCATION – PASTOR BOB DE LEON, CAVALRY CHAPEL ARTESIA

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE – MISS ARTESIA, CANDACE MITCHELL

PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council is asked to fill out a speaker card and give
that card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting.
Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the
end of the meeting. If a member of the public submitted public comments on a Consent
Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for separate
discussion and to hear the public comment on the Consent Calendar item at that time.
Public comments may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us
before 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting. Public comments for items not listed on the
agenda will be heard at this time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council
is prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer
the matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or other
issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATIONS
  • WOMEN’S EQUALITY DAY PROCLAMATION
  • NATIONAL NIGHT OUT PROCLAMATION
  • CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION FOR ALL ABOUT HAIR
  • CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION FOR HALO CLUB
  • PRESENTATION OF PORTRAITS TO THE 2023 MISS ARTESIA AND COURT
  • STAFF INTRODUCTIONS

BUSINESS PRESENTATION
  • CHAMBER OF COMMERCE UPDATES
  • INTERNATIONAL STREET FAIR & DIVERSITY FESTIVAL UPDATE
  • 166TH ST. IMPROVEMENT PLAN

CONSENT CALENDAR
It is recommended that Items (1) through (11) be acted on simultaneously in one vote
unless a member of the City Council requests separate discussion and/or action on the
item. In the event a member of the City Council requests separate discussion on a
Consent Calendar item, or the item is removed from the Consent Calendar to allow for
public comments on the item to be read. The City Council will consider that item
immediately following approval of the rest of the Consent Calendar.
 1.  WAIVING OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTIONS AND ORDINANCES
  STAFF REPORT

2.  ACCOUNTS PAYABLE CHECK REGISTER
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

3.  CITY FINANCIAL REPORT – JUNE 2023
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

4.  CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

5.  CONSIDERATION OF FINDINGS TO CONTINUE THE EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL
  EMERGENCY RELATED TO WINTER STORMS
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

6.  CONSIDERATION OF SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO.
  23-945, REPEALING AND REPLACING TITLE 9 (PLANNING AND ZONING),
  CHAPTER 2 (ZONING), ARTICLE 42 (DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS FOR THE
  INSTALLATION OR CONSTRUCTION OF WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION
  FACILITY SITES, ANTENNAS AND MONOPOLES); AND MAKING CONFORMING
  AMENDMENTS TO ARTICLE 20 (DESIGN REVIEW APPROVAL), SECTION 9-
  2.2002 (PROJECTS SUBJECT TO DESIGN REVIEW APPROVAL BY PLANNING
  COMMISSION OR STAFF), AND SECTION 9-2.2005 (CRITERIA FOR APPROVAL
  OF DESIGN REVIEW APPLICATIONS), AND ARTICLE 4 (DEFINITIONS); AND
  MAKING A DETERMINATION THAT THE PROJECT IS EXEMPT FROM
  ENVIRONMENTAL REVIEW PURSUANT TO STATE CEQA GUIDELINES
  SECTIONS 15378, 15061(b)(3), 15302, 15303 AND 15304
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

7.  CONSIDERATION OF INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 23-946, AMENDING
  VARIOUS SECTIONS OF THE ARTESIA MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO THE
  POWERS AND DUTIES OF THE CITY MANAGER, CITY CLERK, AND CITY
  TREASURER AND OTHER RELATED SECTIONS AND MAKING A
  DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION FROM CEQA PURSUANT TO CEQA
  GUIDELINES 15061(B)(3)
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

8.  CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 23-2953, ETHICS TRAINING FOR
  COMMISSION AND COMMITTEE MEMBERS ESTABLISHING ETHICS TRAINING
  REQUIREMENTS FOR APPOINTED CITY OFFICIALS.
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

9.  CONSIDERATION OF AN AGREEMENT WITH RAMIREZ PRODUCTIONS AND
  EVENT RENTALS, INC. FOR EVENT PRODUCTIONS SERVICES FOR THE 2023
  INTERNATIONAL STREET FAIR AND DIVERSITY FESTIVAL IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $68,196
   STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

10. CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 23-2952, APPROVING A HIGHWAY
  PERMIT FOR THE TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF A PORTION OF PIONEER
  BOULEVARD BETWEEN 183RD STREET AND 187TH STREET, PURSUANT TO
  VEHICLE CODE SECTION 21101(E) IN CONNECTION WITH THE ARTESIA
  INTERNATIONAL STREET FAIR AND DIVERSITY FESTIVAL AND PARADE TO
  BE HELD ON SATURDAY, OCTOBER 7, 2023, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION
  OF EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA GUIDELINES PURSUANT TO SECTION 15301(c)
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

11. CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 23-2947, APPROVING REVISION NO. 1
  TO, AND AMENDING, THE CONSTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION WASTE
  RECYCLING PROGRAM POLICY AND PROCEDURES
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

PUBLIC HEARING
12. CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 23-2954, APPROVING THE BUILDING
  & SAFETY FEE SCHEDULE PER LOS ANGELES COUNTY FEE SCHEDULE, AND
  MAKING A DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA GUIDELINES
  PURSUANT TO SECTION 15273(a)(4)
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

CITY MANAGER INFORMATIONAL REPORTING

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for Councilmembers to report on external boards and committee meetings
attended and meetings attended at public expense. Additional general comments,
announcements, and requests of staff and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers
may also be presented at this time.

ADJOURNMENT
NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING – SEPTEMBER 11, 2023
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at
least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the City Clerk and
are available for inspection.
